name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) - Central Schemes
description: Single-window electronic platform aggregating Central Government, State Government, and UGC/AICTE-backed scholarship schemes. Students generate a 14-digit OTR number via Aadhaar to apply for multiple scholarships including pre-matric, post-matric, merit, minority, and disability welfare scholarships.
benefits: Multiple scholarships under one portal: tuition fee reimbursement, maintenance allowance, merit awards ranging from ₹5,000 to ₹1,00,000+ per annum depending on scheme. Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to Aadhaar-linked bank account.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card (linked with active mobile number for OTR)
Caste / Community Certificate (if applying under SC/ST/OBC/EBC schemes)
Disability Certificate (if applying under Divyang schemes)

criteria.description: Applicant must be an enrolled student
criteria.disqualification_reason: NSP scholarships are only available to enrolled students

criteria.description: Aadhaar card is mandatory to generate OTR (One Time Registration) number on NSP
criteria.disqualification_reason: Aadhaar is a mandatory prerequisite for NSP registration (OTR number generation)

criteria.description: Active bank account seeded with Aadhaar required for Direct Benefit Transfer
criteria.disqualification_reason: An Aadhaar-linked bank account is required for scholarship amount via DBT
